sellmod.error.player_only: This command can only be used by a player
sellmod.help.currencyguard: /sell currencyguard [true|false] - forbid selling the currency and pricing it
sellmod.cmd.currency_has_price: %s has a sell price. Remove the price before making it the currency.
sellmod.cmd.price_is_currency: %s is the currency and cannot be sold.
sellmod.menu.title: SELLING
sellmod.menu.currency.hint: What sold items are paid in. Click to pick the item
sellmod.cmd.currency_guard_on: Currency guard is on: the currency cannot be sold or priced
sellmod.cmd.currency_guard_off: Currency guard is off: the currency can be sold like any item
sellmod.menu.currency_guard.hint: The currency cannot be sold, priced or replaced by an item that has a price. Off lets a sold currency pay out itself, which can mint money from nothing
sellmod.menu.set_price.hint: Pick an item and set its price right away
studio.sell.title: Buyback editor
studio.sell.mode.hint: A shelf opens on the right: your inventory and every item. Drag an item to the middle to give it a price, or on the currency page to make it the currency.
studio.sell.price_row.hint: How much currency a player gets for one piece.
studio.sell.new_price.hint: The price an added item gets. You can change it in its properties right away.
studio.sell.art.currency: The buyback and the shop pay with this item
studio.sell.empty: The buyback is empty. Press Add and drag items from the shelf on the right.
studio.sell.empty_currency: No currency set. Press Change currency and drag an item.
studio.sell.shelf.currency: Drag an item to the middle: it becomes the currency
sellmod.money.mode.item.hint: Money is the currency item: a balance is the number of those items in the inventory
sellmod.money.mode.account.hint: Money is a number on the player's account. Switching converts nothing: accounts wait in the world file, items stay items
sellmod.money.deathloss_set: Share of the account lost on death: %s%%.
sellmod.money.error.limit: The account of %s would go over the limit.
sellmod.money.error.no_room: %s has no room in the inventory for that much.
sellmod.money.error.offline_items: %s is offline: in item mode the balance is in their inventory.
sellmod.money.info.rules: Starting balance %s, lost on death %s%%, reset at match start: %s.
sellmod.money.resetonstart_on: Accounts are reset at match start.
sellmod.pay.error.downed: You cannot pay while down or spectating.
sellmod.pay.error.no_room: %s has no room in the inventory for the whole sum.
sellmod.pay.error.too_fast: Too fast, try again in a moment.
sellmod.transfer.title: Transfer
sellmod.transfer.button.hint: Send money to another player who is online.
sellmod.transfer.amount.hint: Type the amount. Spaces between digit groups are fine.
sellmod.transfer.all.hint: Put your whole balance into the amount.
sellmod.transfer.gone: The player has left the game
sellmod.transfer.send.hint: Money leaves at once and cannot be taken back. The first press arms the button, the second one sends.
sellmod.transfer.pick: Pick a player on the left
sellmod.studio.money.empty: No accounts yet: they appear as players join the server
sellmod.studio.money.shelf.hint: Drag an item to the showcase or double-click it
sellmod.studio.money.account_only: Works only in the Account mode
sellmod.studio.money.mode.hint: Item: money is a stack of the currency item in the inventory. Account: money is a number on the server, items are not needed. Switching converts nothing.
sellmod.studio.money.mode.confirm.hint: Applies the new mode to the whole server right away.
sellmod.studio.money.warn.to_item: Accounts hold %s. In the Item mode these sums do nothing and are not paid out as items: they come back only if the Account mode is turned on again.
sellmod.studio.money.warn.to_account: Players online carry %s as items. It stays in inventories and does not go to the accounts: they start from what they already hold.
sellmod.studio.money.currency.hint: In the Item mode this item is the money. In the Account mode selling it credits its face value to the account.
sellmod.studio.money.icon.hint: The account icon in the HUD, the shop and the transfer window. Without it a coin is drawn.
sellmod.studio.money.name: Currency name
sellmod.studio.money.name.hint: Up to 24 characters. Empty means the default name.
sellmod.studio.money.start.hint: What a new account gets, and what every account is set to when it is reset at match start.
sellmod.studio.money.death.hint: Share of the account lost on death during a match. A killer who is a player takes it, otherwise it burns.
sellmod.studio.money.reset_start.hint: Every account returns to the starting balance when a match starts.
sellmod.studio.money.reset_all.hint: Sets every account to the starting balance. Cannot be undone, works on the second press.
sellmod.studio.money.balance.hint: Type the exact sum: it goes to the server after a short pause.
sellmod.studio.money.amount.hint: How much the Credit and Debit buttons and the right-click menu move.
sellmod.studio.money.credit.hint: Adds the step sum to the account.
sellmod.studio.money.debit.hint: Takes the step sum from the account, never below zero.
sellmod.studio.money.bulk.amount.hint: Group credit and debit move this sum on every marked account.
sellmod.studio.money.log.subject: %s, %s
sellmod.pay.error.recipient_dead: %s is dead: coins can only be passed after respawn.
sellmod.pay.error.start_locked: Starting money can be spent but not transferred. You can send up to %s.
